manifesto.title: A fresh approach
manifesto.subtitle: to villa holidays.
manifesto.lead: Bringing a fresh perspective to villa rentals, Minta Hills Kemer Villas offers an unforgettable holiday at the foothills of the Taurus Mountains. With magnificent <mark>views of the Bey Mountains</mark> and <mark>20,000 square metres</mark> of orange groves, discover every shade of green, reconnect with nature and wake up to birdsong in comfortable and elegant living spaces.
manifesto.description: Our eight villas, each offering 145 square metres of living space, are designed to provide guests with a unique experience. Each villa features an open-plan kitchen, three bedrooms, three toilets, two bathrooms and three balconies, allowing you to enjoy a spacious and comfortable environment.
